tools.name: list_esim_destinations
tools.description: Every country and multi-country region SimOwl sells travel eSIMs for, with the lowest price and the page URL.

tools.name: check_phone_esim_support
tools.description: Whether a phone model supports eSIM: "iPhone 13", "Galaxy S23", "Pixel 7a", or an Android model code such as "SM-S911B". Returns supported, not_supported or unknown.

tools.name: estimate_trip_data
tools.description: How much mobile data a trip needs, and the plan size to pick, for light, typical or heavy use.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_esim_destinations · Public sink: find_esim_plans.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_esim_destinations · Public sink: find_esim_plans

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
